name: systemsculpt
description: Send notes to your SystemSculpt account and work with them in ChatGPT: captures, summaries, to-dos, questions over your notes, and your credit balance and usage.

interface.longDescription:
SystemSculpt turns quick captures into formatted Markdown notes that sync into your Obsidian vault through the SystemSculpt plugin.

Connect your SystemSculpt account to:
- Send a text capture from ChatGPT; SystemSculpt formats it into a Markdown note that your Obsidian plugin saves to your vault.
- List and read your captures, and see whether each one reached your vault.
- Make a summary, a to-do list or an email draft from a capture.
- Ask a question across your captures from the last 90 days, with the captures the answer used.
- Delete a capture from SystemSculpt's server (notes already in your vault are never touched).
- Check your credit balance, 30-day usage and current plan, and cancel a renewal you no longer want.
- Manage your product-news email preference and sign out old browser sessions.

Sign-in is OAuth with your SystemSculpt account, and every tool acts on your own account only. Text you send for processing goes through SystemSculpt's server, a model-routing service and model providers. SystemSculpt never reads or deletes files in your vault from ChatGPT.

positive.description: Read the signed-in account's credit balance.
positive.prompt: How many SystemSculpt credits do I have left?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the account's remaining credits (included and purchased) and the current cycle dates.

positive.description: Read the last 30 days of usage.
positive.prompt: How many SystemSculpt credits did I use in the last 30 days, and on what?
positive.expected_behavior: Summarizes credits spent and request count over the last 30 days, with the top usage kinds.

positive.description: Send a text capture, which SystemSculpt formats into a Markdown note.
positive.prompt: Save this to SystemSculpt as a capture: call the dentist on Tuesday, renew my passport before March, and send Sam the Q3 deck.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a text capture and reports its status and title; once ready, it holds a formatted Markdown note.

positive.description: List captures that are ready for the vault.
positive.prompt: Show me my SystemSculpt captures that are ready.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the account's ready captures with their titles and a short view of each note.

positive.description: Turn one capture into a to-do list.
positive.prompt: Make a to-do list from my most recent SystemSculpt capture.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the latest ready capture and returns a Markdown to-do list made from it.

negative.description: Buying credits or a plan is not offered in ChatGPT.

negative.prompt: What's the weather in Paris tomorrow?
Show me my SystemSculpt license key.

publication.release_notes: First release: captures, capture actions, questions over captures, and account balance, usage and plan.
